Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: In the “Analyze Optimal Strategy” step, the Orchestrator incorrectly optimized Bob’s guesses by setting each guess to the minimum coin count of the actual (hidden) distribution and summing 3×min(a,b,c). This tailors guesses to the distribution after the fact, whereas Bob must commit to a single triple of guesses that works across all valid distributions. This invalid max–min formulation led directly to the underestimated result ($3,000) instead of the correct $16,000.
